limits: Fidelity is not established: the check does not show that FOUNDATIONS §4 states the rule model.py encodes; that is a reviewer's judgement against the bound section digests

The oracle properties are this check's reading of the single result algebra requirement and of the cited lines of FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results; their fidelity to those sources is likewise a reviewer's judgement

The encoding and the oracle share an author, the C2 Writer, who wrote model.py first. P0 and P4 rest on the requirement alone; the other properties cite FOUNDATIONS §4, which is also model.py's source, so for them the oracle is independent of the encoding only in being written without reading or calling it

P5 checks this encoding's reading that, with every mandatory result satisfied, agreeing bases and no gap, the declared rule gives satisfied (Reported value, 930-935); FOUNDATIONS leaves that value to the declared rule

The choice among non-satisfied values is modelled as the set of values a declared rule may report; every value in the set is checked, so every declared order is covered, but no particular declared rule is. A variant whose reported set is a non-empty subset of that set is itself a lawful declared rule, so it is no counterexample: falsified_reported_indeterminate differs from the model on 206 cases and is falsified on 142

No property forces falsified where falsified is returned together with another non-satisfied value: FOUNDATIONS sets no order among them (Reported value, 919-921; Results, Standing, 706-707), so such a property would add an order that FOUNDATIONS leaves to the declared rule
Domain: one to three mandatory components, each contributed by its own evaluation; the empty conjunction is not in the domain
Basis relations are fixed at agreeing: the invalid_basis rule for disagreeing bases (Reported value, 921-924) is not exercised

Excluded, outside the interface of model.py as well as the domain: a falsified result that is not mandatory stays in the record (Reported value, 929-930); and a material counterexample to a mandatory constraint, found by any contributor, falsifies the conjunction where every mandatory result is satisfied, bases agree and no gap remains (930-933). A component's own falsified value never meets that condition, so in this domain FOUNDATIONS forces falsified for a known failure only through 916-919 (P8). Encoding either clause needs the declared rule's choices of how results that are not mandatory count and whether any may veto or defer (The declared rule, 937-942), and an explicitly selected further claim

The declared rule's other choices (handling of conflict and indeterminacy, the decision authority; 937-942), Survival's conflicted mandatory result (902-904) and Composition of results (946-951) are not modelled
Coverage is one obligation, uncovered or absent; no part of a join covers another part's obligation, so the recomputation of uncovered coverage is exercised only where it changes nothing
Joins are two-way splits of one flat conjunction into contiguous parts, combined as a union of component records; nested conjunctions whose parts carry their own composite predicates are not modelled

Predicates and domain outcomes are represented only by component position (Predicates travel, 906-910); refinements and their mappings, effects whose completion is unknown, and the separation of availability, assessment and acceptance (requirement items 2 to 5 beyond this domain) are not exercised
A failed or refused run writes no result; an older result file stays bound to its own digests
A finite check on the declared domain only: no claim beyond it, and no categorical or universal claim
